FastAPI sets the response status code from the `status_code=` parameter on the route decorator, not from what you return. `@app.post('/items', status_code=201)` is the one-liner fix for the first failing test.

For 404s, `raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Item not found')` is the FastAPI idiom — never let a `KeyError` propagate to the client. Check `if item_id not in _store` before accessing the dict.

DELETE returning 204 No Content means the function should return `None` (or nothing). FastAPI omits the response body automatically when the declared status is 204. Add `status_code=204` to the `@app.delete` decorator and remove any `return` statement.
